name: hyprwrlds-vimarchy
author: agf
description: Vimarchy-style overview for hyprwrlds worlds. ALT+CTRL+SPACE: the current world's occupied workspaces side by side; ALT+SHIFT+SPACE: one row per world. Windows are outlined boxes with letter hints (a-z, then Shift A-Z); typing a hint jumps to that window. Source: ~/Work/hyprpi/hyprwrlds-vimarchy (install with ./install.sh).
